meta.name: ANIME x HIDIVE
meta.description:
Your go-to spot for anime. Dive into fantasy, slice-of-life, romance and more. Whatever you’re into, you’ll find it here. ANIME x HIDIVE is where anime fans belong.

Shows: Ushio & Tora, Helck, The Eminence in Shadow, Call of the Night, Dusk Maiden of Amnesia
Available on: Pluto TV, Samsung TV Plus, Plex
